TEXT.French: Commandant Illustre

TEXT.English: Great Commanders can be used to either recruit units, build a Command Post in a city, or be added to another unit to increase its strength and the rate it gains experience points from combat. The recruit ability offers a quick random assortment of units, but the Command Post tends to have a better long term effect as it adds Great Commander points to the city making getting another all the more likely. A commander that is joined with a unit can always be split from the unit later on and used for other purposes, or joined to a different unit.

TEXT.German: Genialer Feldherr können benutzt werden, um entweder Einheiten zu rekrutieren, einen Kommandoposten in einer Stadt zu errichten, oder einer anderen Einheit hinzugefügt werden, um deren Stärke und die Geschwindigkeit mit der sie Erfahrungspunkte aus Kämpfen erhält zu steigern. Die Fähigkeit zu rekrutieren gewährt eine schnelle zufällige Auswahl von Einheiten, aber der Kommandoposten hat gewöhnlich einen besseren Langzeiteffekt, da er der Stadt Genialer Feldherr-Punkte hinzufügt, die es wahrscheinlicher machen, einen neuen Genialer Feldherr zu bekommen. Ein Genialer Feldherr der einer Einheit zugeteilt ist, kann später jederzeit von dieser Einheit getrennt werden und für andere Zwecke benützt werden, oder einer anderen Einheit zugeteilt werden.

TEXT.French: Undead Thrall

TEXT.English:
The undead masses of the spires do not moan and thrash in the way a reanimated corpse would normally behave.
These automaton husks fulfil their tasks like cogs in a machine, efficient and thoughtless. The only sounds to be heard from a great spire city are the soft clicks of bone on metal and the sandblown winds flowing from the rooftops.

TEXT.French: Greenhorn

TEXT.English:
The Grigori gain their signature unit, the [LINK=UNIT_ADVENTURER]Adventurer[\LINK] by assigning Greenhorns in their cities, hoping that one of them will rise to become a hero of the people.
Greenhorns are would-be Adventurers, yet to earn their cape but eager to prove themselves with odd jobs, and duking it out with rats in a basement with nothing but a leather shield.

TEXT.French: Volunteer

TEXT.English:
When men put their faith in gods, the divine can happen. When men put their faith in themselves, anything can happen.
The Grigori are a decentralised people, wanderers move from town to town, and subsistence is the norm. Performing odd jobs and filling in for others who have wandered off is often the only way to put food on the table. But the Grigori don't mind; it is a small price to pay to be free of the madness of faith outside their home.
(Education, Taxation, Guilds, and Trade technologies increase this specialist's yields)

TEXT.French: Apostate
Great Luonnotar

TEXT.English:
The Grigori Apostate preaches not of god, but of home. Not of Zeal, but of vigilance. Not of hate, but of scepticism.
Giving their speeches on turned-over oxcarts, these men goad and guide the flocks of the Grigori to hone their scythes and harden the tips of their pitchforks. By their will, the sheep of the fold will carry tools of war to meet the wolves head-on.
This is a time of urgency; no expense can be spared to protect our homes.

TEXT.French: Sister of the Healing Church

TEXT.English:
Zaria's hallowed influence has brought a new and blessed order into being: The Healing Church! These sisters of the faith offer medical care and support to all citizens of the Mekara Order.*
Some sisters go above and beyond their peers, elevating themselves into great saints who radiate an aura of divinity so strong that sometimes entire towns seem to bend to their will.
Strangely, opponents of the church seem to frequently come down with incurable illnesses, or a severe case of gravity.
*Members of the slave cast are exempt from citizenship.

TEXT.French: Test Subject

TEXT.English:
The Mekara gain their signature unit, the [LINK=UNIT_ASPIRANT]Aspirant[\LINK], by settling Slaves into their cities as Test Subjects, so that one of them might achieve something notable in their meaningless lives.
"It's all part of the plan, it's all a part of the plan!" Hooks bite into flesh. "Believe in Iram! Believe in Iram!" Hatchet severs digits. "FOR THE GOOD OF US ALL! FOR THE GOOD OF US ALL! FOR THE GOOD OF US ALL!" "Test 334 is too loud; remove the tongue." The lead Shaper stated flatly. Scalpel pierces flesh. Silence. "Good. Now, I'm starving. Who brought lunch?"
